name: The Naughty Girl Adventures
source:
Today is your lucky day! Your greatest wish has finally come true, but... Nothing is ever as perfect as it seems. You know it yourself that the devil never sleeps. There are many challenges ahead of you, chances that you're supposed to use so you continue following your passion, because that's exactly where you are going to leave your personal mark.

[From in-app]
translation:
今天是你的幸运日！你最大的愿望终于实现了，但是……一切都不像看起来那么完美。你自己也知道魔鬼从不睡觉。你面前有许多挑战和机会，你应该利用这些机会继续追随你的激情，因为这正是你将留下个人印记的地方。

[来自应用程序内]
